### Judgment on Shebna
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/judgment-on-shebna
Passage: Isaiah 22:15-25
Points:
- God singled out Shebna to display divine judgment against pride, deceit, and self-promotion.
- Shebna presumed his position was secure, even constructing an elaborate personal tomb to honor himself.
- The Lord dismantled Shebna's pride, stripping his authority and transferring his office to Eliakim.
- Believers can rest assured that God remains in sovereign control and will ultimately humble corrupt leaders.

### The Problem with Leaders
Author: Darryl Dash
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/straight-paths/the-problem-with-leaders/
Passage: Isaiah 22:15-25
Points:
- Shebna illustrates the destructive temptation leaders face to seek personal prestige rather than serve others.
- God actively opposes and humbles those who exploit their positions for selfish ambition.
- Even godly leaders like Eliakim ultimately fail when forced to bear unrealistic human expectations.
- Believers should look past earthly leaders and place their ultimate trust in Christ alone.
